items.title: 阿联酋迪拜Tasreef第三阶段授出30亿迪拉姆雨水排水工程合同
items.title_en: Dubai awards AED3 billion stormwater drainage works contracts under Tasreef Phase 3
items.summary: 迪拜市政府10月25日宣布Tasreef第三阶段四项雨水排水工程合同，总值30亿迪拉姆，建设及扩建约100公里排水主管线，服务面积近100平方公里。
items.summary_en: On 25 October Dubai Municipality announced four contract awards worth AED3 billion under Phase 3 of the Tasreef stormwater programme, covering about 100 km of main drains across nearly 100 sq km.
items.why_it_matters: 四项建设合同已授予，属于已确定的市政基建工程，非公开招标邀请。
items.why_it_matters_en: The four civil-works contracts have been awarded; this is an infrastructure delivery update rather than an open bid invitation.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注已授标承包商的分包、设备和管材采购。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor subcontracting, equipment and pipe procurement by the awarded contractors.

items.title: 阿曼公布三个矿业勘探区块，总面积约2062平方公里
items.title_en: Oman announces three mineral exploration blocks spanning approximately 2,062 sq km
items.summary: 阿曼公布三个矿业勘探特许区域，总面积约2062平方公里，涉及铜、铬铁矿、金、镍及锰等矿产。具体申请条件仍应依主管机关正式文件核实。
items.summary_en: Oman announced three mineral exploration concession areas totalling around 2,062 sq km, involving minerals including copper, chromite, gold, nickel and manganese. Formal application conditions require verification with the authorities.
items.why_it_matters: 目前属于勘探机会披露，不能视为已证实商业矿藏或采矿合同授予。
items.why_it_matters_en: These are exploration opportunities, not proven economically recoverable deposits or awarded mining contracts.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注后续特许经营申请及地勘服务需求。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor concession application details and geological-survey service demand.

items.title: 阿曼马斯喀特OQ承诺2000万里亚尔支持青年中心总部建设
items.title_en: OQ commits RO20 million to development of youth centre headquarters in Muscat
items.summary: OQ签署2000万阿曼里亚尔资金支持协议，用于建设马斯喀特青年中心总部，拟配备创业孵化、共享办公、培训及技术创新设施。尚未披露正式施工招标。
items.summary_en: OQ signed a RO20 million funding agreement supporting construction of the youth centre headquarters in Muscat, intended to include incubation, coworking, training and innovation facilities. No construction tender has been confirmed.
items.why_it_matters: 明确的是资助协议，并非工程承包合同或采购招标。
items.why_it_matters_en: A funding agreement has been announced, not an EPC award or live procurement notice.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注设计、施工及专业设施采购后续公告。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Watch for design, construction and specialised facilities procurement.

items.title: 阿曼PDO授出涉及15台设备的五年油井提升服务合同
items.title_en: Oman's PDO awards five-year well-lift services contracts involving 15 units
items.summary: 阿曼石油开发公司向Abraj Energy Services及Shaleem Petroleum授出五年油井提升与维护相关服务合同，合计涉及15台设备，其中6台现代化设备拟在当地组装。合同总金额未披露。
items.summary_en: Petroleum Development Oman awarded five-year well-lift and maintenance services contracts to Abraj Energy Services and Shaleem Petroleum, covering 15 units in total. Six modern units are planned for local assembly. The total value was not disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: 已经授予油田服务合同，不能将15台设备误称为合同金额。
items.why_it_matters_en: The oilfield services contracts are awarded; 15 units denote equipment scope, not monetary contract value.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注设备组装、维护及服务供应链机会。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track equipment assembly, maintenance and associated oilfield supply-chain opportunities.

items.title: 葡萄牙Riba de Ave RESINORTE新废弃物筛选设施4000万欧元工程招标
items.title_en: Portugal's RESINORTE tenders EUR40 million new waste sorting facility in Riba de Ave
items.summary: 葡萄牙RESINORTE招标建设位于Riba de Ave的新废弃物筛选设施，估算金额4000万欧元，编号CPI - 001/2026/RSN。欧盟采购页面列示2026年12月10日截止。
items.summary_en: RESINORTE is tendering construction of a new waste-screening facility in Riba de Ave, Portugal, estimated at EUR40 million under CPI - 001/2026/RSN. The EU procurement portal lists a 10 December 2026 deadline.
items.why_it_matters: 仍在有效采购期内，估算金额不等于已授标金额。
items.why_it_matters_en: This remains a procurement opportunity; the estimated value is not a contract award.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注招标文件、投标资格及合作施工承包商。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Review tender documents, eligibility and potential construction partners.

items.title: 葡萄牙BRAVAL生态园再生水设施639万欧元设计建设运营招标
items.title_en: Portugal tenders EUR6.39 million BRAVAL ecopark water-reuse facility design, construction and operation
items.summary: BRAVAL生态园采购再生水生产设施的设计、施工、设备供货、安装调试及运营维护，估算639.283万欧元，编号CP 17/2026。欧盟采购页面列示2026年11月7日截止。
items.summary_en: BRAVAL is tendering design, construction, equipment supply, installation, commissioning, operation and maintenance of a water-reuse production unit at its ecopark. Estimated value is EUR6,392,830, reference CP 17/2026, with a 7 November 2026 deadline on the EU portal.
items.why_it_matters: 设计建设运营一体化采购，金额为预估合同价。
items.why_it_matters_en: An integrated design-build-operate procurement; the figure is an estimated contract value.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注环保工程、设备和联合投标机会。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor environmental engineering, equipment and joint-bid opportunities.

items.title: 葡萄牙Santarém地区Benfica do Ribatejo污水处理厂200万欧元改造工程招标
items.title_en: Portugal tenders EUR2 million Benfica do Ribatejo wastewater treatment plant rehabilitation near Santarém
items.summary: Águas do Ribatejo采购葡萄牙Santarém地区Benfica do Ribatejo污水处理厂改造工程，估算金额200万欧元，编号EMP/010/2026。欧盟采购页面列示2026年11月29日截止。
items.summary_en: Águas do Ribatejo is tendering rehabilitation works at the Benfica do Ribatejo wastewater treatment plant in Portugal's Santarém region, with an estimated value of EUR2 million, reference EMP/010/2026 and a 29 November 2026 deadline on the EU portal.
items.why_it_matters: 水务设施改造工程仍处于公开采购期。
items.why_it_matters_en: The wastewater treatment plant rehabilitation remains an open public procurement opportunity.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注施工与水处理设备供应商投标资格。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Review construction and wastewater-equipment supplier qualification requirements.
